## Problem (parity sibling of the tickets-branch invariant violation)
`alert_store._atomic_write` (`alert_store.py:84`) hand-rolls `tempfile` + `os.replace`
instead of the shared `rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write` seam — the same
hand-rolled-vs-shared-seam class as `projects_store` (ticket `fea4-f98c-f1a2-4168`, LANDED).
This ticket converts that one writer to the authoritative shared seam.

## Scope note — binding-snapshot conversion was ATTEMPTED and REVERTED (behavior-preserving boundary)
The original plan for this parity sweep also proposed routing
`reconcile_helpers._commit_binding_store_snapshot` through
`push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch` (which stages with `git add -A`). That conversion is
**intentionally NOT part of the landed change.** A first patchset that did it FAILED CI:
`tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_idempotency.py::test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head`
went red — on an unchanged second reconcile pass the binding bytes are byte-identical and
`mutation_count == 0`, yet git HEAD advanced. Root cause: the seam's `git add -A` widening
sweeps in OTHER per-pass `.bridge_state` state files (rotation / last-pass / peer_confirmations
markers) that the original selective 5-file staging deliberately excluded, so a redundant
commit is created and reconcile idempotency is broken. That is a real behavioral change, which
falls OUTSIDE the approved scope ("call the authoritative seam AS-IS, only where it is
behavior-preserving"). The binding-snapshot path therefore keeps its original selective-staging
raw-git implementation unchanged. Only the `alert_store` conversion (below), which is genuinely
behavior-preserving, landed.

## Use the EXISTING seam (NO new facade, NO redesign) — same as ticket fea4
`rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write` — the shared crash-atomic write.

## Approach — alert_store._atomic_write -> fsutil.atomic_write (RESIDENCY = LOCAL SCRATCH)
`alert_store` writes to `repo_root/bridge_state/bridge_alerts` (NO dot), which `.gitignore`
(`bridge_state/`) ignores and which is NOT tracked on the tickets branch (only the dotted
`.bridge_state/*` is). So the alert files are local scratch: `fsutil.atomic_write` ALONE is
correct — NO publish/commit path is added.
- The current `_atomic_write` does `parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)` before writing;
  `fsutil.atomic_write` does NOT create the destination directory. KEEP an explicit
  `path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)` immediately before the call, then
  `fsutil.atomic_write(path, content, permissions=0o600, fsync=True)` to preserve exact
  serialized bytes, mode `0o600` (mkstemp default, no chmod today), and fsync-before-replace
  durability.

## Constraints — BEHAVIOR-PRESERVING
No functional change beyond seam adoption: same on-disk alert bytes/mode, same missing-parent
handling. Reuse the existing seam ONLY; add no helper.

## Testing / Verification
- RED-first byte-identity test that `fsutil.atomic_write` produces the same file contents and
  `0o600` mode as the removed hand-rolled path, and that the write succeeds when the parent dir
  does not pre-exist (guards the retained `mkdir`).
- Reconcile idempotency remains green (proving the binding-snapshot path was left unchanged):
  `python -m pytest tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_idempotency.py -q`.
- Proving commands (all must pass): `make lint`; `make typecheck`;
  `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/ -q` (modulo the known-unrelated
  `state/test_ref_lock.py::test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote` flake).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `alert_store._atomic_write` is replaced by `fsutil.atomic_write` with a retained
      `parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)`; residency determined = local scratch
      (documented); no publish path; exact bytes + `0o600` mode + fsync preserved.
      Verified by `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_alert_store_atomic_write.py -q`.
- [ ] The binding-snapshot commit path is left UNCHANGED (raw selective-staging), so reconcile
      idempotency is preserved (no redundant commit on an unchanged second pass).
      Verified by `python -m pytest tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_idempotency.py::test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head -q`.
- [ ] No functional/behavioral change beyond the alert_store seam adoption.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/ -q`
      all pass (modulo the known-unrelated `state/test_ref_lock.py` flake).

## Sequencing
Depends on fea4 (LANDED). Edits `alert_store.py` (+ its test) only — disjoint from A/C/D.
